page_title: FUL 1-1 CRY | Fulham v Crystal Palace 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The ratio of the ball possession is 53:47.

90+4' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
90+3' Armando Broja (Fulham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Fulham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

89' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
87' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Adam Wharton provided an assist for the goal.
86' Here's the change. Tyrick Mitchell leaves the pitch and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
85' Here is a change. Andreas Pereira is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Harry Wilson (Fulham).
85' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Armando Broja (Fulham) replaces Rodrigo Muniz.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Harrison Reed walks off the pitch to be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
83' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
82' 8:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
79' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

77' A wild pass somehow finds Harrison Reed (Fulham) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
76' It's time for a substitution. Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) comes on in place of Jordan Ayew.
75' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
75' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.

74' Willian (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
73' The shot by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Bernd Leno.
72' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
71' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

70' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
69' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Bobby De Cordova-Reid and he is replaced by Willian (Fulham).
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jean-Philippe Mateta as he is replaced by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
69' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sasa Lukic (Fulham) replacing Joao Palhinha.
68' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
67' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
66' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

64' Andreas Pereira slides a brilliant pass into Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
62' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
61' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Crystal Palace as they win a corner.
60' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
58' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation.
56' The free kick is delivered by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
55' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
53' 1 - 0 Goal! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Timothy Castagne and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
52' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. It's a free kick to Fulham in a dangerous position.
51' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
49' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
47' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Referee Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

45+1' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Dangerous play by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Issa Diop (Fulham) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
43' The referee awards a corner and Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take it.

41' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Dean Henderson, who makes a glorious save! Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
37' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jean-Philippe Mateta.
34' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
33' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle.
30' Bernd Leno (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

30' That didn't go as planned! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Bernd Leno, who easily kept it out.
30' A cross from a corner kick by Crystal Palace is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
29' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
27' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

26' A precise low pass is received by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
25' A clumsy foul by Joao Palhinha (Fulham) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Free kick. Crystal Palace will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
23' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
22' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
18' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

17' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul.

16' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
14' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
12' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Crystal Palace players are visibly unhappy with the call.

11' Play continues despite the shouts by some Crystal Palace players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Stuart Attwell interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
11' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
10' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call. Crystal Palace have been awarded a free kick.
9' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) commits a foul and Stuart Attwell immediately signals a free kick.
7' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
5' The ball rebounds out to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
5' Crystal Palace failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Crystal Palace get a corner.
3' The referee blows his whistle as Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in his challenge.
3' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
